title: U-2 photography of Typhoon Winnie, July 1958
description: High-altitude black-and-white photograph showing a large swirling cloud mass of a typhoon from above, with the curvature of the horizon visible. Captioned "U-2 photography of Typhoon Winnie, July 1958." Chapter 5 text (page 217) below mentions a 1959 Hong Kong China Post story on U-2 overflights and begins the section "U-2Cs for Detachment C."
